searchText: No backwards sync, when you get an unknown root Why do you need to do a state transition on backward sync? Oh you mean you get a block with an unknown parent and you need to start requesting back to fill the gap? If that's the case then i don't see what's the big problem: you got a block that refers both a parent blockroot and a parent block hash. You request any of those two that you do not know about.
